ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Oral comments (maximum of 3 minutes) will be heard from people who submit a WHITE speaker's slip to the Commission Secretary. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. No discussion or action may legally be taken on such non-agenda items. If at least two Commissioners agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.

2019-12-09 Minutes

ACTION ITEMS
A.
Intersection Control Evaluation at the intersection of Crest Drive and Melba Road
Approve staff recommendation denying the request for an all-way stop at Crest Drive and Melba Road.
Intersection Control Evaluation at the Intersection of Crest Drive and Melba Road
B.
Amending Standards and Procedures for Establishing Stop Sign Control for City of Encinitas
Approve staff recommendation to use Section 2B.06 and 2B.07 of California Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices, 2014 Edition (2014 CA-MUTCD) for the application of STOP signs in City of Encinitas.
Amending Standards and Procedures for Establishing Stop Sign Control for City of Encinitas
Attachment 1 for Item 7B
C.
New Crosswalk on San Elijo Ave at the intersection of Liverpool Dr and New Crosswalk on South Coast Highway 101 at the intersection of G Street
Approve staff recommendation to install mid-block crosswalks on South Coast Highway 101 at the intersection of G Street and on San Elijo Ave at the intersection of Liverpool Dr. and recommend approval to City Council.
